cards.quote: Marina High School (San Leandro, California) Marina High School was a public high school located in Washington Manor in San Leandro, California, USA, that operated from 1964 to 1982. It was part of the San Lorenzo Unified School District. It opened in September 1964 on Wicks Boulevard with only freshman, sophomore and junior classes.
